Appearance:
MR RUSHABH R SHAH(5314) for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR KI SHAH(766) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 MR KL PANDYA, APP for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018
ORAL ORDER
This Criminal Revision Application is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat, today.
Learned APP Shri K. L. Pandya appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has produced Withdrawal/Settlement purshis, which is taken on record.
Today, Today, Mr. J. A. Salunke, Food Safety Officer from the Surat Municipal Corporation, Surat is present before the Court.
He stated that the original complainant Mr. I. P. Patel has retired from service, and therefore, he is present on his behalf.

Designated Officer, Surat Municipal Corporation has also issued a letter of authority in his favour to remain present stating that as the matter is placed in the Lok Adalat before this Court and if the applicant is ready and willing to deposit the amount of fine, let R/CR.RA/647/2006 ORDER the matter be disposed of.
Such letter of authority is taken on record.
In view of the withdrawal / settlement pursis moved by the parties under the signature as well as learned advocate appearing on behalf of the parties.

sentences.text: 1 As such, on going through the record, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the original accused-revisionist under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.

It is pointed out that by virtue of an Order dated 5th October 2006 passed by this Court, pending hearing and final disposal of the present Criminal Revision Application, the execution,
implementation and operation of the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 31.09.2005 passed by learned J.M.F.C., Municipal Court, Surat in PFA Case No. 60/2000,
which was confirmed by the learned 2nd Additional Sessions Judge, Surat in Criminal Appeal No.
29 of 2005 dated 29.09.2006 has been suspended and the applicant/revisionist is ordered to be released on bail.
In view of purshis of the parties, the present Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of.

The applicant/revisionist is hereby directed to pay fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only] before the High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad within a period of four weeks of this R/CR.RA/647/2006 ORDER Order; as agreed, failing which the Criminal Revision Application shall stand revived automatically.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, this Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of as settled on payment of fine; as aforestated.

The judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 31.09.2005 passed by learned J.M.F.C., Municipal Court, Surat in PFA Case No. 60/2000, which was confirmed by the learned 2nd Additional Sessions Judge, Surat in Criminal Appeal No. 29 of 2005 dated 29.09.2006 stands modified by converting the same into fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only].
Bail bonds stand cancelled.
R&P; if any, be transmitted back to the trial Court.

It is required to be mentioned here that disposal of this matter will not in any way affect any connected cases arising out of the same, incident or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this Order will not be treated as precedent in any future cases for reference.
